messages.subject: <hr> tag throws error in htmlEscape
parts:
An <hr> tag in my shiny app causes an error in shiny:::htmlEscape:
the text arg in the htmlEscape call has the value character(0).
I can prevent the error by fixing htmlEscape, adding this code:
     if(length(text)==0)   text = ""
then using assignInNamespace(ns="shiny", x="htmlEscape", ...)
to place the fixed code for htmlEscape into the namespace;
then the error goes away.

Obviously not a satisfactory solution, so I'm currently doing without <hr>,
not a big sacrifice. 
But the problem may show up with other tags.
It's a very easy fix.

-Roger
